en.quote: There are no conscripts [among those taking part in the operation], and we do not plan to send them; we have no intention of doing so.
en.head: The Defence Ministry acknowledged conscripts took part.
en.body: On March 9, 2022, Russia’s Defence Ministry acknowledged that conscripts had been present in units taking part in the operation in Ukraine and that some had been captured. It said almost all had been withdrawn. This contradicts the categorical “not a single one” in the initial statement.

qsrc.t: Kommersant, report on the meeting, March 5, 2022
